name: v1.8.11
body:
## What's Changed

* Promote registry v1.8.10 to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1874

* Add usage collector for the hosted registry by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1877
* Run the usage collector daily and show its results in Grafana by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1878
* Fix the staging deploy: put the usage collector's generated credentials in Secret data by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1880

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.10...v1.8.11

name: v1.8.10
body:
Improve incremental server listing query selection and planning, including sparse windows and deep pagination (#1865).

Database operators should prebuild both replacement indexes concurrently and validate their definitions before deploying to a busy database; see deploy/README.md. Existing indexes are retained for a separate post-rollout cleanup. API ordering and filtering remain unchanged.

This release also includes the merged HTTP authentication retry and multi-proof verification fixes, publisher private-key file/environment support, and registry UI title improvements since v1.8.9.

name: v1.8.9
body: Optimize incremental-sync pagination by selecting indexed page keys before fetching payloads, while retaining prepared statement reuse. Includes staged production autoscaling configuration and deployment guardrails. See #1840 for validation and rollout details.

name: v1.8.8
body:
This release uses the source commit validated in staging. Different server names may now share a remote URL; consumers should key listings by server name and version rather than assuming URL uniqueness. No database migration is required.
